title: One key shape for per-IP limits
evidence: The app routes key their per-IP limits on the /64 bucket (ipBucket in app-gate.server.ts; app-routes.server.ts, api.chat.ts web turns), while other per-IP limiters key on the address as read (api.feedback, api.events, api.ab, api.measurements, api.google-token, api.lab-import-v2). Use one key shape for all. From the PR 1613 review
